objective: Exact constant-charge minimum-support formulation of the root, defect-tree restrictions and signed cycle exchanges; no universal optimum or descent theorem is asserted.

atomic_claims.text: Every connected eligible graph has exactly 3^(|E|-|V|+1) constant-charge F3 assignments, with an explicit tree extension.
In maximum degree three, every assignment satisfies w=2n/3+b. Weight-2n/3 assignments are in bijection with actual P3-factors.
Every minimum and every single-cycle-local minimum has forest support; defect one consists of a unique arm-length-(1,2,2) six-vertex tree and P3s.
The two oriented cycle update costs are k-p and k-q; local minima obey the stated induced-tree and two-tree distance restrictions.
Complete enumerations on G_2,G_3 have 2187 and 59049 solutions and minima counts 65,297, all explicitly checked as factors. Separate 3400 descent samples are not exhaustive.

assumptions: Finite connected simple graphs of maximum degree at most three and order divisible by three; original root additionally requires cubicity and 3-vertex-connectivity.
P3 denotes a selected two-edge path, not necessarily induced.
Equation (1) is a prescribed nonzero vertex charge over F3; zero edge values are allowed.
risks: Existence of an affine solution is not existence of a minimum with zero defect.
Cycle-local optimality is not assumed to imply global optimality.
Complete affine enumerations concern two explicit graphs, not all graphs of either order.
The 3400 descent starts are bounded samples only.
Local-only code hashes and complete algorithm descriptions are retained without claiming an executable GitHub upload or verifier receipt.
The obsolete strengthening dependency remains untouched and is not assumed; root remains open.
